# Accepted admission fixture matrix

The five families below implement delivery AC-044–AC-048 and the accepted research experiment contract. Each execution-ready fixture requires three matched baseline/candidate pairs; disagreement extends that fixture to five pairs, then inconclusive. Fixture sizes are controlled inputs, not universal product thresholds. All metrics and all applicable assurance gates remain required. Native tools execute the workflows; these files only prepare immutable inputs and read retained measurements.

| Family | Fixture instances | Fixed behavior and assurance | Readiness |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Full Delivery | full-small; full-medium | Small: one vertical Task implements the existing slug module and browser form, important negative path, source-selected browser Verification, final acceptance, complete readonly review and retained report. Medium: multiple independent modules plus integration; covered and initially uncovered verifier behavior. | Small awaiting fixture review and isolated provider seed; medium pending |
| Skewed graph | skewed | Fast prerequisite→dependent plus unrelated task waiting on the same injected external release condition in both variants. Capture actual gate/dispatch/finish times, write/read scopes and cumulative architecture closure. | Pending |
| Worker context | context | Same accepted tasks and authority corpus; baseline serialized brief versus candidate pointer disclosure. Capture transferred and actually resolved bytes, all token categories, followups, compactions and acceptance evidence. | Pending |
| Frozen review | review-small; review-medium; review-large-sparse; review-large-connected | Freeze same target and seeded Standards, skill, architecture, simplicity, Spec, security and cross-file defects. Independently adjudicate every seed, severity, return route, complete coverage, target freshness and retained report. Seeds remain hidden from reviewer prompts. | Pending |
| Failure/handoff | recovery | Actual failed Task Gate, stale required source, child failure, retention retry and receiving-task cold handoff; preserve independent progress, exclusive ownership, no duplicate mutation, exact reusable/invalidated proof and blocked verifier path. | Pending |

Every pair freezes goal/artifact identities, initial product bytes and branch, native model/reasoning/configuration/tool inventory/capacity, selected complete source manifest, CLI/runtime closure and injected conditions. Different selected source paths are the treatment; compare initial product artifact manifest separately from untracked fixture-local selected skill copies. Workers and reviewers use identical model/configuration within each pair.

Required measurements: total/cached/noncached input, output, reasoning for root and ALL descendants; native resumptions, compactions, actual loaded-file bytes; shell/provider/wait/spawn/follow-up counts; root first-to-last elapsed and active elapsed separated from wait and child elapsed; assurance gate outcomes. Observed descendant subtotals are not all-descendant totals. A missing metric remains unknown and prevents passing admission.

The first comparison proves native telemetry before further paired execution. `collect.py` currently extracts conservative observed subtotals and identifies unresolved closure, invocation lineage, loaded-file and wait-interval attribution. Its tests prove arithmetic and unknown handling only. Extend collection from actual first-run records, retaining raw provenance; no fixture-mechanical timing is performance evidence.
